WITH latest_auth AS ( SELECT user_id, auth_status, real_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY auth_time DESC) AS rn FROM auth_info ) SELECT qcc.code_config_name, ws.sign_id, ws.user_id, ws.sign_time, ws.record_id, ws.create_by, ws.create_time, ws.update_by, ws.update_time, ws.remark, ws.version, ws.del_flag, ws.result_type, ws.ip, ws.check_in_type, su.phonenumber as phone_number,su.nick_name, a.real_name,nci.school_name,aa.real_name as sign_name, ss.nick_name as sign_nick FROM wx_sign_in_info ws LEFT JOIN wx_qc_code_record qcr on qcr.record_id = ws.record_id LEFT JOIN wx_qc_code_config qcc on qcc.code_config_id = qcr.code_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su on ws.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN latest_auth a ON a.user_id = ws.user_id AND a.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN identity_info i1 ON i1.user_id = ws.user_id AND i1.del_flag = '0' AND i1.check_status = '6' LEFT JOIN nationwide_college_info nci ON nci.id= i1.school LEFT JOIN sys_user ss on ss.user_id = ws.create_by LEFT JOIN latest_auth aa ON aa.user_id = ws.create_by AND aa.rn = 1

SELECT qcc.code_config_name, ws.sign_id, ws.user_id, ws.sign_time, ws.record_id, ws.create_by, ws.create_time, ws.update_by, ws.update_time, ws.remark, ws.version, ws.del_flag, ws.result_type, ws.ip, ws.check_in_type, su.phonenumber AS phone_number, su.nick_name, a.real_name, nci.school_name, aa.real_name AS sign_name, ss.nick_name AS sign_nick FROM wx_sign_in_info ws LEFT JOIN wx_qc_code_record qcr ON qcr.record_id = ws.record_id LEFT JOIN wx_qc_code_config qcc ON qcc.code_config_id = qcr.code_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ws.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN auth_info a ON a.user_id = ws.user_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_info a2 WHERE a2.user_id = a.user_id AND a2.auth_time > a.auth_time ) LEFT JOIN identity_info i1 ON i1.user_id = ws.user_id AND i1.del_flag = '0' AND i1.check_status = '6' LEFT JOIN nationwide_college_info nci ON nci.id = i1.school LEFT JOIN sys_user ss ON ss.user_id = ws.create_by LEFT JOIN auth_info aa ON aa.user_id = ws.create_by AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_info a2 WHERE a2.user_id = aa.user_id AND a2.auth_time > aa.auth_time );
